verdict.rationale: Isaac is a robotics platform whose Isaac ROS stack runs on embedded Jetson hardware, so on-robot data capture and cloud sync is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no documented on-robot telemetry recording, cloud upload, or bandwidth-aware sync policy. The closest item, capturing stereo camera data from an AMR, describes synthetic data in simulated warehouse scenes, not real on-robot capture, and gives no credit here.
